text: 下面进入大作文 04 · 社会公德与协同互助：同舟共济、爱心接力与拒绝利己冷漠答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：风雨同舟、众人合力撑伞画面的温情定格与公德立意。
Amidst a torrential downpour, passersby are holding a shared umbrella; mutual assistance and collective goodwill are the indispensable glue of a civilized society.
社会公德点题金句：mutual assistance and collective goodwill are the indispensable glue that binds a civilized society together.
Mutual assistance and collective goodwill are the indispensable glue of a civilized society.
第二段：双重说理论证 + 团结名言 + 志愿奉献鲜活案例。
Selfish indifference merely isolates human hearts, whereas cooperative solidarity fosters reciprocal trust; as the proverb proclaims, 'Unity is strength'.
举例论证典范句：A prime case in point is the selfless dedication of community volunteers...
Selfish indifference isolates human hearts, whereas cooperative solidarity fosters reciprocal trust.
第三段：媒体与教育倡导责任，以驱散冷漠、共筑温情倒装收官。
Only when every member of society extends a helping hand can we banish indifference and construct a society brimming with enduring warmth.
温情社会倒装结语：Only when every member extends a helping hand can we banish indifference.
Only when every member extends a helping hand can we construct a society brimming with warmth.
